notes: כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר is split three ways: כְּ takes *According*, אֲשֶׁר takes *as*, and כֹל takes the displaced *in all things*, with the supplied *in* licensed by the nominal (rule 33) and the supplied *things* the generic completing the quantifier (rule 31), headed on *all*. The unit is discontinuous under rule 25; marking *in* `added` was the alternative considered.
*only Jehovah thy God be with thee* writes its own verb, so עִם takes no construction-supplied copula here (rule 49's limit) — the contrast with JOS.1.9's *is with thee* is deliberate.
A written כֵּן carries the *so* of the *as … so* correlative here, which is why JOS.1.5's supplied *so* is `added` there.
